_meta.provenance: OpenAI API pricing page, confirmed via web 2026-11-12. NOT Azure OpenAI, NOT the ChatGPT Enterprise/Business rate cards (both of which Sulabh uploaded 2026-11-12 but neither is his billing surface). The ChatGPT token-based card is FLAT (no 272k tier, no cache-write); the API and Azure are NOT flat.

context_tier.rule: If a request's input tokens exceed 272000, the ENTIRE request (not just the overflow) bills at the long-context rate. Determined per-request from measured prompt_tokens, never from approx_tokens.
context_tier.tuning_note: Re-confirm the 272000 threshold and the long-context multipliers from the OpenAI pricing page on any model change; both were vendor-set as of 2026-11-12.

service_tier_multipliers._note: Multiplier applies uniformly to input, cached, cache_write and output. Flex (service_tier='flex', sync but slower/variable latency, can 429 under load -> fall back to standard) and Batch (async, <=24h) both bill at 0.5x. Fast is 2x. Base rates below are the STANDARD tier per context tier.

gpt-6.1-terra._role: candidate single interpreter model under test

gpt-6-luna._role: Step-5 planner replacement candidate (cheap, small payloads, never near 272k)
